tip

tb

tb

tb

tb

int

archon.title: Archon key points
items: Use {Halo} at the start of big pulls and boss burst, then follow with {Voidform} and {Power Infusion}
Do not waste the {Mind Flay: Insanity} procs from each Halo spawn

voidweaver.title: Voidweaver key points
items: Open {Entropic Rift} with {Void Torrent} and dump {Shadow Word: Madness} during those 8 sec
Line up {Voidform} and {Power Infusion} together for big trash pulls and boss burst windows

Rav'i: [해제] Regurgitate is a Disease effect. Clear hit party members with Purify Disease (Wowhead)

[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on every Ssscavenging shield (Topicx). Press Voidform and Power Infusion (2 min) on the shield they are back for, and use Halo (1 min) on the Archon build or Void Torrent (30 sec) on the Voidweaver build on every shield
[광역 피해] Press Vampiric Embrace (2 min, 12 sec) for Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone), where party defensives go, and keep single-target Shadow spells on the boss to heal the party (Topicx)
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Take one slot with Silence (30 sec) in the three-kick Toxic Atrophy order agreed in chat before the pull (Topicx)
[위치] Shadow has no teleport, so start running just before Death Rattle and drop Angelic Feather under your feet to break the tether (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Press Voidform and Power Infusion together in the Uncoil split where Bloodlust goes (Topicx), spread Vampiric Touch to the Writhes with Tentacle Slam, then chip them down with Void Volley
Zul'jan: [광역 피해] Press Vampiric Embrace (2 min) for the Ritual of the Fang beam-soak channel, where party defensives go (Topicx). On a Ritual where Vampiric Embrace is not back, heal the party with Halo (1 min) on the Archon build
[참고] After Boneslicer clears Ritual Venom, survive the 7 sec Physical DoT with Power Word: Shield and Desperate Prayer

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Holy) does not need a kick rotation. Kick it with Silence (30 sec) when it is available (Topicx)

[위치] Standing inside Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam means taking Loam's Nature damage (77586 every 1 sec) and the beam's Holy damage (77586 every 2 sec) together, so put Power Word: Shield on yourself before stepping in. When the beam ends, offset Loam's 50% slow with Body and Soul (40% movement speed) or Angelic Feather to get out
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Bloodthorn Roots is a Magic effect. If several players are rooted, clear them at once with Mass Dispel; if only you are rooted, escape with Dispersion (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Press Vampiric Embrace for Thorncaller Roar and the post-50% Lightcrazed Frenzy phase
[참고] Bloodlust goes below 50% when no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase is active (Topicx), so line up Voidform and Power Infusion with it. If you are the Gaze target, open distance with Angelic Feather
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Silence into the kick rotation for Moonkin Form's Warden's Wrath

[위치] If you are marked by Pulverizing Strikes, stand still and aim the cone (164870 Physical every 2 sec for 6 sec) away from the group. If Grievous Thrash is still bleeding you, Flash Heal yourself to full before the cone to clear the bleed and take 10% less damage from Protective Light
[광역 피해] Save Dispersion and Desperate Prayer for the Spirits of the Vale phase after 40%
Ziekket: [차단] Before the rez, interrupt the Lashers' Lightspore Shot with Silence; if they are stacked, stop them together with Psychic Scream
[광역 피해] When Lashers spawn, apply Vampiric Touch with Tentacle Slam and cleave them down with Psychic Link

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Turn on Vampiric Embrace for the Ravenous Bellow AoE physical damage, and use Desperate Prayer if your health is low
[위치] If the Spoiled Supplies mushrooms are far, use Angelic Feather to step on one and get back within 12 sec
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Silence in the Winter's Shroud (4 sec cast, 96982 Frost to everyone) rotation of the Fractured Shivercore the ranged players take

[우선 처치] Both Shivercores must die at the same time (Topicx), so keep Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain on both. Do not dump Shadow Word: Madness into the one that is ahead; use single-target spells on the one that is behind to even their health

[해제] Glacial Torment is a Magic effect. Clear it with Mass Dispel when several players have it (Wowhead). Before Frozen Tempest, get into the Snowdrift first with Angelic Feather, so Mass Dispel on the stacked party catches 5 players at once
Nalorakk: [위치] If you are targeted by Echoing Maul, use Angelic Feather to reach this set's agreed corner within 4 sec and drop the Echo there (Topicx). Take the 193965 Nature within 8 yards of the landing Echo with Power Word: Shield
[광역 피해] During Overwhelming Onslaught (315193 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec for 3 sec), stand behind Zul'jarra's shield and press Fade for 10% damage reduction from Translucent Image
[광역 피해] Use Desperate Prayer for the Echoing Fury damage taken while blocking Echoes during Fury of the War God, and use Dispersion if it gets dangerous

Kystia Manaheart: [우선 처치] Line up Voidform and Power Infusion with the first Destabilized (Kystia takes 115% more damage for 20 sec) to bring Kystia to about 40%, so the second window finishes her (Topicx)
[차단] Silence one Mirror Images copy, and stop stacked copies together with Psychic Scream
[해제] Corroding Spittle is a Magic DoT. Clear it with Mass Dispel when several players have it
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The fight starts with the worker pack and the second Bloodlust (Topicx), so press Voidform and Power Infusion, apply Vampiric Touch to the Warehouse Workers with Tentacle Slam, and let Psychic Link chip them down together
[광역 피해] Press Vampiric Embrace for Killing Spree, and use Desperate Prayer if you are low
[위치] Before Murder in a Row finishes casting, use Angelic Feather to get behind a nearby barrel first. Several players can hide behind one barrel
Xathuux the Annihilator: [우선 처치] Line up Voidform and Power Infusion with the second Demonic Rage (the boss takes 30% more damage for 15 sec), where the third Bloodlust goes (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Press Fade for Infernal Crush to reduce damage with Translucent Image, and add Desperate Prayer if the axe is still alive
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Silence in the Chaos Bolt rotation

[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on Vilefiend and Wild Imp spawns, not the boss (Topicx). When the adds appear, press Voidform and Power Infusion, apply Vampiric Touch with Tentacle Slam, then kill them together with Void Volley

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Turn on Vampiric Embrace for the Dark Bloom party shadow damage
[회피] When Void Fissure orbs fly in, sidestep quickly with Angelic Feather
Atroxus: [우선 처치] When a Toxic Creeper appears, switch to it at once with Tentacle Slam and Shadow Word: Madness
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes on the first Toxic Creeper (Topicx), so line up Voidform and Power Infusion with that Creeper. If Bloodlust goes right at the pull, press your cooldowns with it then
[광역 피해] Use Desperate Prayer for Monstrous Roar's party Physical damage, and press Vampiric Embrace while a Creeper is alive
Charonus: [위치] If targeted by Gravitic Orbs, drag the orb to the far Unstable Singularity that the ranged players take (Topicx). Stand next to that Singularity beforehand and pass through quickly with Angelic Feather

[광역 피해] Party survival utility goes on the orb-dragging phase through the pools (Topicx), so press Vampiric Embrace then and keep casting instants such as Shadow Word: Madness and Tentacle Slam while moving to heal the party

The Golden Serpent: [우선 처치] When Lucre's Call spawns Animated Gold, AoE them down with Tentacle Slam and Void Volley, and slow them with Psychic Scream if they are grouped
[참고] This dungeon has long corridors, so use every instant like Tentacle Slam, Shadow Word: Death, and Shadow Word: Pain while moving (Wowhead)
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Silence in the kick rotation for Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge
[해제] Wretched Discharge is a Disease. Cleanse affected players with Purify Disease
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes on Mchimba (Topicx), so line up Voidform and Power Infusion with it. Press Vampiric Embrace when Awakening Slam's AoE overlaps
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] Kula must die before the fourth Whirling Axes (Topicx), so line up Voidform and Power Infusion with Kula, and only apply Vampiric Touch to the Royal Berserker and Honored Raptors you bring in with Tentacle Slam so Psychic Link chips them down
[차단] Put Silence in the kick rotation for Zanazal's Poison Nova
[위치] If you are low during Barrel Through soaks, put Power Word: Shield on yourself and stack
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes at the start of Dazar (Topicx), so line up Voidform and Power Infusion with Reban and kill it before 80%. On a four-Bloodlust route, line them up with the phase 2 Bloodlust
[차단] Put Silence in the kick rotation for Reban's Deathly Roar
[광역 피해] Press Vampiric Embrace for Gilded Destruction's 15 sec party DoT, and use Dispersion if you are low

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank kicks Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands (Topicx). Use Silence only as a backup on a Frigid Shard the tank misses
[해제] Cold Claws stacked on the tank is a Magic effect. If the healer cannot keep up, remove it with Mass Dispel (Wowhead)

[광역 피해] Party survival utility goes on the intermission (Topicx), so press Vampiric Embrace and keep single-target Shadow spells on the boss behind Ice Bulwark to heal the party. When Frost Overload stacks build up, alternate Dispersion and Desperate Prayer (Wowhead)
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Silence in the kick rotation for Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley
[우선 처치] The Firestorm must die before the next Molten Boulder (Topicx), so switch to it at once when it appears and dump Shadow Word: Madness and Shadow Word: Death into it
[광역 피해] For Inferno stack damage when you have no cooldown, self-cast Flash Heal and reduce it with Protective Light (Wowhead)
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [해제] The tank's Stormslam debuff (381515) is a Magic effect. If the healer cannot remove it, use Mass Dispel (Wowhead)

[우선 처치] In phase 1 keep hitting Kyrakka from range even while it circles the arena to kill the dragon first (Wowhead). Save cooldowns for phase 2 and, after the merge, line up Voidform and Power Infusion with the lower-health boss to finish it first (Topicx)

[위치] If targeted by Inferno Spit, move with Angelic Feather to the edge toward the next Winds of Change direction, and take the burst when the circle explodes (end of the 6 sec DoT) with Desperate Prayer or Power Word: Shield (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [참고] One boss is immune from Storm Blessed, so you cannot cleave both; focus Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain on the boss that is not immune (Wowhead)
Merektha: [차단] Put Silence in the kick rotation for Toxic Viper's Poison Spit
[광역 피해] When the Hatch adds appear, spread Vampiric Touch with Tentacle Slam and kill them together
[광역 피해] Party survival utility goes on Serpentstorm (Topicx), so press Vampiric Embrace and keep single-target Shadow spells on Merektha to heal the party
Galvazzt: [위치] When Galvanized stacks up on your beam soak turn, survive by reducing damage taken with Dispersion
[광역 피해] Put Power Word: Shield on yourself before Induction
Avatar of Sethraliss: [우선 처치] Line up Voidform and Power Infusion with the Essence Defiler to kill it fast

[차단] Put Silence in the kick rotation for Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock. When the tank gathers the Hexxer next to the Corrupted Guardian (Topicx), apply Vampiric Touch to both with Tentacle Slam so Psychic Link chips them down together
[제어] In phase 2, stop the Faithless Tormentors chasing the healer with Psychic Scream. Step on an Angelic Feather and run to the green orbs dropped by Tormentors to step on them quickly (Topicx)

Summons a massive shadowy appendage to slam the ground, dealing (68.7926% of Spell Power) Shadow damage in front of you and 8 yds around your target.

Applies Vampiric Touch to up to 6 enemies, prioritizing ones without Vampiric Touch.

Generates 6 Insanity.

1231346.d:
Shadow Word: Madness increases your haste during Voidform by 2% and increases its duration by 1.5 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

When Voidform ends, the haste lingers and decays over 10 sec.

1242173.d:
Releases a volley of pure void energy, firing 10 bolts at your target and 1 bolt at all enemies within 10 yards of your target for (95.44% of Spell Power) Shadow damage.

Generates 10 Insanity.

1242862.d: Increases the critical strike chance of Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain by 8% and their critical strike damage by 20%.

1279353.d: Tentacle Slam afflicts your target with Shadow Word: Madness at 25% effectiveness.

17.m: 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 7.5 초 재사용 대기시간
17.d: 15초 동안 아군을 보호막으로 감싸 0의 피해를 흡수합니다.

453.m: 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 5 초 재사용 대기시간
453.d: 해당 지역 내 적의 시야를 흐려 적을 인식하는 범위를 10미터만큼 감소시킵니다. 인간형과 용족 대상에게만 가능하며 위협 수준을 생성시키지 않습니다. 20초 동안 지속됩니다.

528.m: 특성 · 14% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
528.d: 적 대상에게 걸린 이로운 마법 효과 1개를 제거합니다.

586.d: 몸을 희미하게 만들어 10초 동안 자신의 위협 수준을 모두 없앱니다. 추가로 적에게 감지당하는 범위가 감소합니다.

589.d:
어둠의 권능으로 즉시 (주문력의 16.8%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 추가로 16초에 걸쳐 총 (주문력의 99.68%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

3의 광기를 생성합니다.

2061.m: 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
2061.d: 빠른 치유 주문으로 아군의 생명력을 (주문력의 682%)만큼 회복시킵니다.

8092.m: 특성 · 4% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 9 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
8092.d:
대상의 정신을 강타하여 (주문력의 78.336%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

6의 광기를 생성합니다.

8122.m: 특성 · 1.2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 40 초 재사용 대기시간
8122.d: 영혼의 절규를 부르짖어 주위 8미터 내의 모든 적이 8초 동안 달아나며 방향 감각을 상실하게 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다.

10060.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
10060.d:
대상에게 마력을 주입하여 15초 동안 가속을 20%만큼 증가시킵니다.

플레이어에게만 시전할 수 있습니다.

15286.d: 12초 동안 암흑의 기운으로 충만해져, 자신이 단일 대상에게 입히는 암흑 주문 피해의 40%만큼 주위 아군의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.

15407.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (4.5 초 주문 시전 시간)
15407.d:
대상의 정신을 암흑의 기운으로 공격하여, 4.5초에 걸쳐 총 (주문력의 828.828%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

지속시간에 걸쳐 18의 광기를 생성합니다.

15487.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
15487.d: 대상을 침묵시켜 5초 동안 주문을 시전하지 못하게 합니다. 플레이어가 아닌 대상을 상대로는 주문 시전을 방해하고, 4초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하게 합니다.

19236.d: 10초 동안 최대 생명력을 [빛의 감화: 35 / 25]%만큼 증가시키고, 증가한 만큼의 생명력을 즉시 회복합니다.

21562.d:
대상에게 성스러운 기운을 불어넣어, 1시간 동안 대상의 체력을 5%만큼 증가시킵니다.

대상이 같은 파티나 공격대에 속해 있다면, 모든 파티원과 공격대원이 효과를 받습니다.

32375.m: 특성 · 20% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
32375.d: 15미터 반경 내의 마법을 무효화하여 아군 대상 5명에게 걸린 모든 해로운 주문을 제거하고, 적 대상 5명으로부터 1개의 이로운 주문을 제거합니다. 일반 무효화 주문으로 해제할 수 없는 마법도 해제할 수 있습니다.

32379.m: 특성 · 0.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
32379.d:
어둠의 힘으로 대상에게 (주문력의 85%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 어둠의 권능: 죽음으로 사망하지 않으면 최대 생명력의 5%에 해당하는 반발 피해를 받습니다.

생명력이 20% 미만인 대상에게는 피해량이 150%만큼 증가합니다.

1의 광기를 생성합니다.

34914.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
34914.d:
어둠의 손길로 21초에 걸쳐 총 49의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 적에게 입힌 피해량의 30%만큼 자신의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.흡혈의 손길을 해제하는 적은 3초 동안 공포에 휩싸여 도망칩니다.

4의 광기를 생성합니다.

47585.d:
순수한 암흑 마력으로 흩어져 6초 동안 받는 모든 피해가 75%만큼 감소하고 지속 시간에 걸쳐 최대 생명력의 [(25 + 0) * (0 + 6) / 6]%만큼 회복합니다. 하지만 적을 공격하거나 주문을 시전할 수 없습니다.

이동 속도가 50%만큼 증가하고, 모든 이동 방해 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

기절, 공포, 침묵 상태에서도 시전할 수 있습니다.

55676.d: 영혼의 절규 시전 시 대상이 도망치지 않고 제자리에서 공포에 떱니다.

64129.d: 신의 권능: 보호막 및 신의의 도약 시전 시 대상의 이동 속도가 3초 동안 40%만큼 증가합니다.

73325.m: 특성 · 2.6% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
73325.d: 파티원이나 공격대원의 영혼을 끌어당겨 즉시 자신의 앞으로 이동시킵니다.

120644.m: 특성 · 4% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
120644.d: 자신의 주위로 40미터 반경까지 급속히 팽창하는 암흑 에너지 고리를 생성하여, 아군의 생명력을 (주문력의 161%)만큼 회복시키고 적에게 [(주문력의 144.2%) * 1 * 1 * 1]의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 6명을 초과하면 치유량이 감소합니다. [암흑: 5의 광기를 생성합니다.]

121536.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간 · 3회 사용 가능
121536.d: 대상 장소에 깃털을 놓습니다. 가장 먼저 깃털을 통과해 지나는 아군은 5초 동안 이동 속도가 40%만큼 증가합니다. 동시에 3개의 깃털만 놓을 수 있습니다.

193063.d: 자신에게 순간 치유 시전 시 10초 동안 받는 모든 피해가 10%만큼 감소합니다.

199484.d:
직접 공격 주문 시전 시 40미터 내의 흡혈의 손길에 걸린 다른 모든 대상에게 입힌 피해의 20%에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다.

그림자 원혼, 어둠의 권능: 고통, 흡혈의 손길로 입힌 피해에는 이 효과가 적용되지 않습니다.

205364.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.8 초 주문 시전 시간 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
205364.d: 30초 동안 자신보다 최고 1레벨 높은 생명체의 정신을 조종합니다. 악마, 기계형, 언데드 대상이나 플레이어에게는 사용할 수 없습니다. 이 주문은 다른 방향 감각 상실 효과와 점감을 공유합니다.

213634.m: 특성 · 10% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
213634.d: 아군 대상에게서 모든 질병 효과를 제거합니다.

228260.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
228260.d:
공허 연사로 대상에게 폭격을 가하고 어둠의 형상을 공허 마법으로 뒤틀어 20초 동안 주문 공격력이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

공허의 형상이 지속되는 동안 공허 연사가 이 주문을 대체하며, 최대 3회까지 사용할 수 있습니다.

공허 연사
순수한 공허 마력을 일제히 방출해 대상에게는 10발의 화살을, 대상의 10미터 내에 있는 모든 적에게는 1발의 화살을 발사해 (주문력의 95.44%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

10의 광기를 생성합니다.

232698.d: 어둠의 형상을 취해 주문 공격력을 10%만큼 증가시킵니다.

238558.d: 흡혈의 손길이 대상에게 어둠의 권능: 고통도 함께 부여합니다. 어둠의 권능: 고통의 지속시간이 5초만큼 증가합니다.

263165.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (3 초 주문 시전 시간) · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
263165.d:
대상에게 공허의 힘이 깃든 격류를 집중시켜, 3초에 걸쳐 (주문력의 713.055%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 혼돈의 균열을 엽니다.

혼돈의 균열
정신 분열 시전 시 혼돈의 균열을 열어 8초 동안 적을 따라다니게 합니다. 균열에 휘말린 적은 범위 안에 있는 동안 1초마다 (주문력의 60%)의 암흑 피해를 받습니다.

지속시간에 걸쳐 24의 광기를 생성합니다.

335467.m: 특성 · 광기 50 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 어둠의 형상 필요
335467.d:
광기 어린 말을 대상의 정신에 속삭여 즉시 (주문력의 261.625%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 추가로 6초에 걸쳐 9의 추가 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 입힌 피해의 30%만큼 생명력을 회복합니다.

대상에게 다시 부여하면 남은 모든 피해가 새로운 효과에 합산됩니다.

341491.d: 어둠의 권능: 광기 시전 시 자신의 흡혈의 손길에 걸린 모든 대상에게 느린 속도로 다가가 (주문력의 85.05%)의 암흑 피해를 입히는 그림자 원혼을 불러냅니다.

373446.d: 소실 시전 시 받는 피해가 10%만큼 감소합니다.

373450.d: 구원의 기도로 증가하는 최대 생명력이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

373466.d:
마력 주입을 아군에게 사용하면 100%의 효율로 자신에게도 시전합니다.

대상으로 지정된 아군이 없으면 주위의 아군 한 명에게 100%의 효율로 부여됩니다. 공격 담당에게 우선적으로 부여됩니다.

375888.d: 어둠의 권능: 고통으로 주기적인 피해를 입히면 일정 확률로 다음 정신 분열을 즉시 시전할 수 있고 재사용 대기시간을 무시합니다.

377065.d: 생명력이 최대일 때 흡혈의 손길이나 어둠의 권능: 광기로 치유를 받으면 동일한 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 생성합니다. 보호막의 피해 흡수량은 최대 생명력의 10%를 초과할 수 없습니다

391090.d:
정신의 채찍으로 피해를 입히면 정신 분열의 치명타 및 극대화율이 8%만큼 증가합니다. 최대 12번까지 중첩됩니다.

10초 동안 지속됩니다.

391228.d: 흡혈의 손길이 20%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 또한 피해를 입힐 때마다 일정 확률로 1의 광기를 생성합니다.

391399.d: 정신의 채찍의 공격력이 15%만큼, 광기 생성량이 30%만큼 증가합니다.

391403.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (1.5 초 주문 시전 시간)
391403.d:
대상의 정신을 암흑의 기운으로 공격하여, 1.5초에 걸쳐 총 (주문력의 623.716%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 이동 속도를 70%만큼 감소시킵니다.

지속시간에 걸쳐 8의 광기를 생성합니다.

447444.d: 정신 분열 시전 시 혼돈의 균열을 열어 8초 동안 적을 따라다니게 합니다. 균열에 휘말린 적은 범위 안에 있는 동안 1초마다 (주문력의 60%)의 암흑 피해를 받습니다.

448403.d:
어둠의 권능: 광기를 시전할 때마다 혼돈의 균열이 강화되어 공격력과 크기가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

혼돈의 균열은 효과가 끝나면 붕괴하여 15미터 내의 적 대상에게 (주문력의 440%)의 암흑 피해를 나누어 입힙니다.

449806.d: 후광이 시전자를 중심으로 발동하며, 최대 거리에 도달한 후에는 시전자에게로 돌아옵니다. 또한 후광을 통과할 때마다 아군을 치유하고 적에게는 피해를 입힙니다.

449880.d: 혼돈의 균열이 활성화된 동안 암흑 공격력이 5%만큼 증가합니다.

450405.d:
혼돈의 균열이 활성화된 동안 정신 분열이 공허의 폭발로 강화됩니다.

공허의 폭발:
적에게 폭발하는 우주의 공허 마력을 내보내 (주문력의 210%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. [암흑: 0의 광기를 생성합니다.]

451018.d: 공허의 격류를 움직이면서 사용할 수 있습니다. 혼돈의 균열이 활성화된 동안 이동 속도가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

451234.d:
혼돈의 균열이 끝날 때 5초 동안 붕괴된 균열에서 공허의 망령이 소환됩니다.

공허의 망령
공허의 망령을 소환합니다. 공허의 망령은 멀리 떨어진 거리에서 공허의 채찍을 시전합니다. 공허의 채찍은 생명력이 높은 적에게 추가 피해를 입히며, 대상의 생명력이 최대치일 경우 최대 50%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 공허의 망령이 공격할 때마다 1의 광기를 생성합니다.

451311.d: 40미터 내 아군이 자신보다 더 많은 생명력을 가졌을 경우, 3초마다 자신의 생명력의 4%에 해당하는 생명력을 흡수합니다.

451840.d: 어둠의 권능: 죽음이 대상에게 부여된 피해 흡수 보호막을 흡수하여 (주문력의 255%)의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 또한 보호막이 있다면 5의 광기를 회복합니다.

453109.d: 후광 시전 시 추가로 10초 동안 5초마다 주위에 100%의 효율로 후광을 생성합니다.

453783.d:
후광 시전 시 다음 정신의 채찍이 정신의 채찍: 광기로 강화됩니다.

정신의 채찍: 광기
대상의 정신을 암흑의 기운으로 공격하여, 1.5초에 걸쳐 총 (주문력의 623.716%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 이동 속도를 70%만큼 감소시킵니다.

지속시간에 걸쳐 8의 광기를 생성합니다.

453917.d: 공허의 형상이 활성화된 동안에는 공격력이 5%만큼 증가합니다.

454001.d:
후광 시전 시 공허의 형상의 지속시간이 1초만큼 증가합니다. 공허의 형상이 활성화되어 있지 않다면 최대 6초까지 저장합니다.

전투 중이 아니거나 제어 불가 효과에 영향을 받는 동안에는 공허의 형상의 지속시간이 최대 20초만큼 일시 정지됩니다.

1227280.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
1227280.d:
어둠의 부속물을 소환해 지면을 강타하여 시전자 전방과 대상 주위 8미터에 (주문력의 68.7926%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

최대 6명의 적에게 흡혈의 손길을 겁니다. 흡혈의 손길이 부여되지 않은 적에게 우선적으로 겁니다.

6의 광기를 생성합니다.

1231346.d:
공허의 형상의 지속시간 동안 어둠의 권능: 광기가 가속을 2%만큼 증가시키고 지속시간을 1.5초만큼 연장합니다. 최대 5번까지 중첩됩니다.

공허의 형상이 끝나면 가속 증가 효과가 남아, 10초에 걸쳐 서서히 사라집니다.

1242173.d:
순수한 공허 마력을 일제히 방출해 대상에게는 10발의 화살을, 대상의 10미터 내에 있는 모든 적에게는 1발의 화살을 발사해 (주문력의 95.44%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다.

10의 광기를 생성합니다.

1242862.d: 흡혈의 손길 및 어둠의 권능: 고통의 극대화율이 8%만큼, 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

1279353.d: 촉수 격돌이 대상에게 25%의 효율로 어둠의 권능: 광기를 겁니다.

1: [차단] Take one of the two kick slots that make Radiant Spellsower walk to the tank with Silence (30 sec). Silence stops Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy) and locks that school for 4 sec.

[제어] Neither Mythic+ build has a stun. When a Spellsower gets low, channel Mind Flay (50% movement slow) on it to slow its Call The Grove run, and on the Archon build use the Mind Flay: Insanity from Manifested Power (70% slow) on that target.

[광역 피해] Once everything is stacked and Bloodlust is up, press Voidform (2 min) with Power Infusion (2 min), and open with Halo (1 min) on the Archon build or Void Torrent (30 sec) on the Voidweaver build. Press Desperate Prayer (1.5 min, 35% max health for 10 sec) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).
2: [차단] Decide before the pull which of the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley your Silence covers. If both cast together and kicks run short, step within 8 yards of the tank and stop both casts with Psychic Scream (30 sec, Psychic Voice).

[우선 처치] A Lightgorged Lasher with its Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108) is immune to crowd control, so do not rely on Psychic Scream for it. Use Shadow Word: Death on that Lasher; on the Voidweaver build Devour Matter consumes the shield for extra damage.
[광역 피해] If Desperate Prayer (1.5 min) is not back for Spouting Floret, put Power Word: Shield on yourself and Flash Heal yourself for Protective Light (10% damage reduction for 10 sec).
3: [광역 피해] When the 12 Lashers are stacked, use Tentacle Slam (15 sec recharge, 2 charges) to apply Vampiric Touch to up to 6 mobs at a time, and let Psychic Link spread your single-target damage to every mob with Vampiric Touch.

[제어] Channel Mind Flay on whichever of the two Radiant Spellsowers gets low to hold it with the slow. If both run, chase within 8 yards and use Psychic Scream. Petrifying Scream makes them tremble in place, but damage may break it.
5: [차단] Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech is a long cast one ranged player can handle alone, but Silence has a 30 sec cooldown so Shadow cannot solo it (Topicx). Leave it to a ranged player with a short kick and use Silence on any cast they miss.

[제어] Leave stunning Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap to a party member with a stun. If you are the target, get out of the cone with Angelic Feather (20 sec recharge, 3 charges) or Power Word: Shield (Body and Soul, 40% movement speed).
[광역 피해] Use Desperate Prayer on the first-pulled Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and spread Vampiric Touch with Tentacle Slam once the Virid Grovekeeper arriving 5-6 sec later is stacked too.
7: [차단] Leave Disorienting Screech to a ranged player with a short kick and use Silence on Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature).
[광역 피해] The two Luminous Thornmaws have a lot of health and live long, so time Voidform and Power Infusion for this pull and put Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch on both Thornmaws first.

[참고] While Spiny Shield (absorbs 500090) is up on the 5 Spineshield Beetles, hitting them returns 4849 Nature damage, so keep Power Word: Shield on yourself. On the Voidweaver build Shadow Word: Death with Devour Matter consumes and breaks the shield.
8: [차단] Silence one of the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot.
[광역 피해] Use Desperate Prayer for Spouting Floret. If Desperate Prayer (1.5 min) is not back after pull 7, take it with Power Word: Shield and a self Flash Heal (Protective Light).
10: [광역 피해] Shadow cannot remove Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew poison (Purify Disease only removes Disease and Mass Dispel only Magic). During the 9 sec poison DoT, press Vampiric Embrace (2 min, 12 sec) and focus single-target Shadow spells on the Matriarch to heal nearby allies.

[우선 처치] When the two Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, break that Lasher first with Shadow Word: Death (extra damage from Devour Matter on the Voidweaver build). Hit Potadpole Eggs together with Tentacle Slam when they appear.
11: [차단] Cover one of the three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech with Silence, and if two or more cast together, step within 8 yards of the tank and stop them with Psychic Scream.
[광역 피해] Press Desperate Prayer for Spouting Floret, and put Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch on the Luminous Thornmaw first so Psychic Link chips it down alongside the pack.
12: [우선 처치] When the six Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, stack Voidform and Power Infusion on this pull, spread Vampiric Touch with Tentacle Slam, then break the Lashers still shielded with Shadow Word: Death (Devour Matter on the Voidweaver build).
[차단] Decide which of the two Radiant Spellsowers your Silence covers, and channel Mind Flay on a low Spellsower to hold it with the slow. Press Desperate Prayer for Spouting Floret.

1: [차단] Decide before the pull which of the two Primal Serpents your Silence (30 sec) covers. Silence stops Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical, 30% haste reduction) and locks that school for 4 sec.

[해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every 1 sec for 20 sec, 10% movement slow per tick) is a Magic effect. If several party members are hit, clear them at once with Mass Dispel (2 min, removes harmful Magic from 5 allies within 15 yards); if only you are slowed, escape with Dispersion (immune to movement impairing effects).

[광역 피해] This is the first pull, so press Voidform (2 min) with Power Infusion (2 min). When the 8 Venom Leeches and 7 Ravenous Descendants are stacked, use Tentacle Slam (15 sec recharge, 2 charges) to apply Vampiric Touch to 6 mobs at a time and let Psychic Link chip them down together.
2: [우선 처치] Put Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch on the Ritual Chieftain first, and line up Halo (1 min) on the Archon build or Void Torrent (30 sec) on the Voidweaver build with the Chieftain. Silence Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss.

[광역 피해] For Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to everyone, absorbs the next 162029 healing), press Vampiric Embrace (2 min, 12 sec) and focus single-target Shadow spells on the Chieftain to help clear the party's healing absorb. Add Desperate Prayer (1.5 min, 35% max health for 10 sec) if you are low.
3: [차단] Silence one of the three Primal Serpents that walk down behind the pillar, and if the rest stacked at the tank cast Piercing Hiss together, step within 8 yards and stop them with Psychic Scream (30 sec, Psychic Voice).
[우선 처치] Line up Halo (Archon) or Void Torrent (Voidweaver) with the Ritual Chieftain again. Put Power Word: Shield on yourself right before Blood Sacrifice.
4: [우선 처치] Cover one Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Silence and focus Shadow Word: Madness on the Ritual Chieftain to kill it before Blood Sacrifice comes several times.
5: [광역 피해] At 103 trash count this is the biggest pull. If the Voidform and Power Infusion (2 min) used on pull 1 are back, press them here and keep single-target spells on the Ritual Chieftain until it dies.

[해제] If both Twinfang Harrowers spread Paralyzing Shots across the party, check whether Mass Dispel is back and clear it. If Blood Sacrifice and the Paralyzing Shots DoT overlap and drop you hard, press Dispersion (2 min, 75% damage reduction for 6 sec).
[차단] Silence one of the two Primal Serpents.
7: [차단] Silence High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast). If no kick is left for Evolve (6 sec channel), stop it with Psychic Scream from within 8 yards.

[우선 처치] The shield from a completed Evolve (absorbs 250045, immune to crowd control) is a Magic effect. Strip it with Dispel Magic; on the Voidweaver build Shadow Word: Death with Devour Matter consumes the shield for extra damage.
[광역 피해] Put Power Word: Shield on yourself right before Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every 1 sec for 5 sec), and press Vampiric Embrace with it if it is back.
8: [제어] Neither Mythic+ build has a stun. When the 4 Bloodletters are stacked at the tank, use Psychic Scream from within 8 yards. Petrifying Scream makes them tremble in place and briefly stops their melee and blood pools, but damage may break it.
[광역 피해] Use Desperate Prayer for Rattle; if it is not back, take it with Power Word: Shield and a self Flash Heal (Protective Light, 10% damage reduction for 10 sec).
9: [차단] Take the far-left High Evolutionist that is easy to leave behind (Topicx). Silencing its Mass Envenom from 40 yards locks that school for 4 sec so it walks to the pack.
[우선 처치] Line up Voidform and Power Infusion with the two High Evolutionists to kill them before the second Mass Envenom. Strip any Evolve shield with Dispel Magic.
11: [차단] Decide which of the four High Evolutionists your Silence covers, and if Evolutionists stacked at the tank channel Evolve together, stop them all with Psychic Scream from within 8 yards.
[우선 처치] If several Evolutionists gain Evolve shields, strip them at once with Mass Dispel (removes 1 beneficial Magic effect from 5 enemies); if only one has it, use Dispel Magic.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest (Topicx). Line up Voidform and Power Infusion with this miniboss, and only apply Vampiric Touch to the two pulled Blades of the Altar with Tentacle Slam.

[광역 피해] When Infest (34914 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yards) hits you, put Power Word: Shield on yourself and stack on the tank's marked spot. Get out of Virulent Whirl impacts with Angelic Feather (20 sec recharge, 3 charges).
13: [차단] Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so put Silence (30 sec) in one slot of the rotation.

[우선 처치] Tentacle Slam on the six Living Venoms applies Vampiric Touch, and Psychic Link then splits your damage on the Chosen onto the Venoms and can melt them all at once. If the Venoms are stacked, hold Tentacle Slam and use single-target spells on the Chosen.
[광역 피해] Press Vampiric Embrace for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every 1 sec for 9 sec), and dodge the Toxic Beam lines with Angelic Feather.
14: [차단] Put Silence in the Mass Envenom rotation for Ula'tek's Chosen. If Vampiric Embrace (2 min) used on pull 13 is not back, take Toxic Surge with Desperate Prayer.
[우선 처치] Do not aim Tentacle Slam and Psychic Link cleave at the Living Venoms so they do not die together; kill the Chosen first.
15: [차단] Silence one of the two Primal Serpents.
[해제] If Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots spreads, clear it with Mass Dispel; without Mass Dispel, escape your own slow with Dispersion.
16: [광역 피해] Two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifice plus Toxic Surge make this the heaviest healing pull (Topicx). Line up Voidform and Power Infusion with Ula'tek's Chosen to kill it before the second Toxic Surge, and press Vampiric Embrace for Blood Sacrifice.
[차단] Put Silence in the Mass Envenom rotation, and press Dispersion if you drop hard.

1: [우선 처치] This is the Bloodlust pull with Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together (Topicx). Line up Voidform (2 min) and Power Infusion (2 min) with Bloodlust to kill the Captain first, and use Halo (1 min) on the Archon build or Void Torrent (30 sec) on the Voidweaver build on the Captain.

[참고] Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison is a poison that Shadow cannot remove. If Row Hooligan's Cutpurse bleed lands on you, put on Power Word: Shield and self Flash Heal for Protective Light (10% damage reduction for 10 sec).
2: [차단] Each Seductive Sayaad needs one player on its Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) (Topicx). Take one with Silence (30 sec).
[해제] The Seduction disorient is a Magic effect. If several party members are hit, clear them at once with Mass Dispel (2 min, removes harmful Magic from 5 allies within 15 yards).
3: [차단] The two Felonious Mages' Fel Missiles channels are spare kicks. Use Silence on one, and apply Vampiric Touch to the six Felwyrms with Tentacle Slam (15 sec recharge, 2 charges).
4: [우선 처치] Shadow cannot remove the four Street Sneaks' Heartstop Poison stacks. Focus Tentacle Slam and Shadow Word: Madness on the Sneaks to kill them fast and cut the stacks building on the tank.
5: [우선 처치] Kill Massive Felwyrm first (Topicx). Line up Shadow Word: Madness and Halo (Archon) or Void Torrent (Voidweaver) with it, and leave its death Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yards) with Angelic Feather (20 sec recharge, 3 charges).
[광역 피해] When Over-infused's Burning Fel (38793 Fire within 50 yards every 3 sec) builds up, press Vampiric Embrace (2 min, 12 sec) and keep single-target Shadow spells on the Massive Felwyrm.
8: [차단] Silence one of the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel. Shadow cannot remove Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast) enrage, so align the kick rotation so it is not missed.
[우선 처치] Below 50%, Shivan Punisher deals Fire damage to the party with Demonic Frenzy until it dies. Press Voidform and Power Infusion at 50% and focus Shadow Word: Madness on it.
9: [광역 피해] If you are the target of Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life, press Dispersion (2 min, 75% damage reduction for 6 sec). Without a defensive the Warlock heals a lot (Topicx).

[우선 처치] When the Warlock shields itself with Dark Pact at 50%, on the Voidweaver build Shadow Word: Death with Devour Matter consumes it for extra damage. Apply Vampiric Touch to the eight Demon Flies with Tentacle Slam and let Psychic Link chip them down together.
[참고] Curse of Doom is a curse Shadow cannot remove. If nobody can dispel it, stack within 4 yards of the target to split the damage.
10: [차단] Silence Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel (Topicx).
[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, focus it with Shadow Word: Madness and Halo (Archon) or Void Torrent (Voidweaver), and chip the Demon Flies down together with Tentacle Slam.
11: [우선 처치] Line up Voidform and Power Infusion with Felmaster Lucsei so its Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec) does not come more than three times (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Split personal and party defensives (Topicx). Press Vampiric Embrace for the second Blade Dance and Desperate Prayer (1.5 min, 35% max health for 10 sec) for the third. Dodge the Eye Beam frontal away from the group.
13: [광역 피해] Party defensives go on Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (2 sec cast, 145474 Fire to everyone) (Topicx). Press Vampiric Embrace and keep single-target Shadow spells on the Golem to heal the party. Dodge the nearby Defiled Detonations (193965 Shadow within 5 yards) with Angelic Feather.
[광역 피해] Apply Vampiric Touch to the six Unleashed Imps with Tentacle Slam and let Psychic Link chip them down together.
14: [차단] Use Silence on Fel Invoker's Health Funnel or Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage. Kill the six Unleashed Imps together with Tentacle Slam and Halo (Archon).
15: [우선 처치] Drag Corrupted Warlock back and kill it first, then kill Shivan Punisher separately (Topicx). Press Dispersion if you are the Drain Life target, and line up Voidform and Power Infusion when the Punisher drops below 50%.
[참고] If nobody can remove Curse of Doom, stack within 4 yards of the target to split the damage.
16: [광역 피해] Focus damage so Defiled Golem's AoE ends within two casts (Topicx). Line up Voidform and Power Infusion with the Golem, and cover one of the two assigned party defensives by pressing Vampiric Embrace for Defiled Slam.
[회피] Dodge Fel Beam by walking backward toward the last boss (Topicx). Put Power Word: Shield on yourself to get out with Body and Soul (40% movement speed). Silence Fel Invoker's Health Funnel.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust and cooldown pull (Topicx). Line up Voidform (2 min) and Power Infusion (2 min) with Bloodlust, and open with Halo (1 min) on the Archon build or Void Torrent (30 sec) on the Voidweaver build. Spread Vampiric Touch on the stacked mobs with Tentacle Slam (15 sec recharge, 2 charges).

[우선 처치] When Spirit of Hunger's Starvation Effigy totem appears, switch at once and break it with instant damage such as Shadow Word: Death and Mind Blast. Press Desperate Prayer (1.5 min, 35% max health for 10 sec) for the Feast of Misery channel (38793 Shadow every 1 sec for 5 sec).
[참고] Shadow cannot remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath enrage or the Insatiable Hunger curse. Leave the soothe and the curse dispel to party members who have them.
2: [차단] Of Earthwhisper Tender's Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) and Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast), use Silence (30 sec) on Healing Breeze first.

[우선 처치] If a missed Healing Breeze puts a heal effect on the mobs, that effect is Magic. Strip it with Dispel Magic, and if several mobs have it, remove them at once with Mass Dispel (2 min, removes 1 beneficial Magic effect from 5 enemies).
3: [차단] Silence Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze and strip a missed Healing Breeze effect with Dispel Magic. Switch to the Starvation Effigy totem with Shadow Word: Death right away.
4: [우선 처치] Break the Starvation Effigy totem first and focus Shadow Word: Madness on Spirit of Hunger to kill it before Insatiable Hunger reaches 2 stacks. If the three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleeds stack on you, put on Power Word: Shield and self Flash Heal for Protective Light (10% damage reduction for 10 sec).
5: [차단] While the tank drags this pack to the boss spot, Silence Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss (Topicx). If the Voidform and Power Infusion used on pull 1 are back, press them here and spread Vampiric Touch to all 8 mobs with Tentacle Slam so Psychic Link chips them down together.
[차단] Decide which of the two Earthwhisper Tenders your Silence covers. If both cast Healing Breeze together, stop them with Psychic Scream (30 sec, Psychic Voice) from within 8 yards of the tank.
8: [우선 처치] On the Voidweaver build, Shadow Word: Death (10 sec) with Devour Matter consumes Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield for extra damage. On the Archon build, focus Shadow Word: Madness on the Rumbler to break the shield.
[광역 피해] While the shield is up, 24246 Nature hits everyone every 2 sec, so press Vampiric Embrace (2 min, 12 sec) and keep single-target Shadow spells on the Rumbler to heal the party.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull (Topicx). Line up Voidform and Power Infusion with Bloodlust and break Terra Rumbler's shield with Shadow Word: Death (Devour Matter on the Voidweaver build).
[차단] Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% haste and movement speed reduction) is a long cast and easy to kick, so cover one with Silence.

[해제] Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge is Magic, but Shadow can only remove Magic from allies with Mass Dispel. Normally move more than 4 yards from the party when targeted, and use Mass Dispel only when two or more players have it.
10: [차단] Silence one of the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar.

[광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust (Topicx), but the Voidform (2 min) used on pull 9 is not back. Use Halo (Archon) or Void Torrent (Voidweaver) here, and move away from the party when targeted by Cryo Surge.
11: [우선 처치] Kill Avatar of Determination first and Terra Rumbler next (Topicx). Line up Shadow Word: Madness and Halo (Archon) or Void Torrent (Voidweaver) with the Avatar, and break the Rumbler's shield with Shadow Word: Death (Devour Matter on the Voidweaver build).
[회피] Cast from range during Pulverize (4 sec cast, 387930 Physical and a 4 sec stun within 12 yards), and if it comes to you, get beyond 12 yards with Angelic Feather (20 sec recharge, 3 charges).
13: [차단] Silence one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, jumps to up to 3 players).
[우선 처치] Break Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem at once with Shadow Word: Death and Mind Blast. Use Desperate Prayer for Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (stacking armor-ignoring Physical).
14: [광역 피해] This is a third Bloodlust candidate (Topicx). If Bloodlust goes here, press Voidform and Power Infusion with it; if the group saves Bloodlust for Loa Speaker Nanea on high keys, save your cooldowns for Nanea too.
[우선 처치] Break both Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems at once with Shadow Word: Death, and Silence Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning.
